//: The host and everything it bundles. The packages are checked again, more strictly, with their own tsconfig; here the flags are the ones the motor's SDK sources pass. `lib` is ES2024, matching crates/graph-sdk-js/tsconfig.json, because `src/main.ts` reaches `motor/local.ts` and so the SDK's encoder — which refuses a lone surrogate with the ES2024 String.prototype.isWellFormed. `target` stays ES2022: that is what the bundle is emitted for.
